title: Penalized estimation of GEV parameters for extreme quantile regression
summary: Quantile regression (QR) relies on the estimation of conditional quantiles and explores the relationships between independent and dependent variables. At high probability levels, classical QR methods face extrapolation difficulties due to the scarcity of data in the tail of the distribution. Another challenge arises when the number of predictors is large and the quantile function exhibits a complex structure.
